usedFor: tawk.to holds the chats and tickets, and Google Drive copies a file through “Copy a File” after “Chat Ends”.

bestTemplate.name: “Chat Ends” in tawk.to, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: The action copies a file into a chosen folder with a new name, so each chat gets its own copy.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens a file by link, so check its access level before tying it to chats.
